fees.notes: City University Malaysia does not publish an international fee schedule: the official International Students page states the latest fee structure is available only from the International Marketing Office (imo@city.edu.my) or CityU representatives on request, and the official programme page and programme listing show no tuition fee. Sources checked: https://city.edu.my/admission-scholarships/international-students/; https://city.edu.my/foundation-in-arts-graphic-design-multimedia/; https://city.edu.my/programmes/foundation/ (all accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: SPM: Possess SPM or equivalent with a minimum of 5 credits in any subjects including English. English Competency Requirement: Determination of Malay and English grade requirements at the SPM level for admission to programs under the body professionals are in accordance with the standards/manuals/stipulations of the relevant professional bodies.
